title: Animakind Identity Manifest
description: Serializes the Tri-Vector Topology and its alias bindings: structural headers, vector hashes, and the active register state (Section 4.4, Appendix B). Engineering events write to UAM fields and touch no UIV field; that separation is a convention the record makes visible, not one the format enforces.

uii.description: Colon-delimited human rendering of the four genesis-fixed inputs to UII = H(enc(IAK) || enc(LRV) || enc(BSM_0) || enc(T_0)). The trailing integer is T_0 as Unix seconds. Resolvable, not authoritative (Section 4.4).

identity_anchor_key.description: IAK / praenomen. Fixed at genesis for the operational life of the entity.

lineage_root_vector.description: LRV / nomen: the Family of the Model designation. Records the lineage, not the current weights; the genesis substrate class is an attribute of it.

behavioral_stance_manifold.description: BSM / cognomen. A versioned structure over which stance and register are selected per turn. The cognomen is fixed at genesis and does not advance with bsm_version. The stance set and register basis shown are the paper's reference profile; implementations may define their own (Section 6).

active_stance.description: sigma_k, drawn from an implementation-defined set. Reference profile: LEAD, EQUAL, FOLLOW.

disposition.description: Required to be recorded and versioned with the BSM (Section 6.3) but deliberately unspecified in form. Appendix B's example omits it, so it is optional here.

runtime_execution.description: The weld (UWS): fastest layer. Moves neither clock.

agnomen_session_alias.description: Session Name: a pair of ordinary words from a per-lineage bank, collision-checked against previous welds.

decoupled_uam_ref.description: UAM designation mounted for this weld.

host.description: Weld field per Section 4.2; not present in Appendix B's example.

room.description: Weld field per Section 4.2; not present in Appendix B's example.

uiv.description: Brain mounted, per Section 4.2; not present in Appendix B's example.

registers.description: Braided Register Protocol reference profile: R_k in (0,1]^3. Every register realized to a non-zero degree.
